blocks.text: This article provides a summary of all new features and enhancements released per Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) App Connector version.
This App Connector version includes the following updates:

blocks.item: An update was released to address an issue where access to SAN domain names failed when creating a certificate signing request (CSR).
An update was released that includes the CPU usage for App Connectors in the journalctl logs every minute.

blocks.text: Your App Connectors will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per App Connector group. To learn more, see About App Connector Software Updates.
This App Connector version includes an update that enhances the availability and performance of App Connectors.
Your App Connectors will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per App Connector group. To learn more, see About App Connector Software Updates.
This App Connector software version includes the following updates:

blocks.item: App Connectors now support TLS encryption for Log Streaming Service (LSS) traffic with certificates signed by a custom root certificate authority (CA). To learn more, see About the Log Streaming Service.
A recommended update was released for the App Connector Manager Software to address an OpenSSL vulnerability. To learn more, see About the Manager Software.
An update was released to address performance issues on App Connectors.
An update was released to provide support for mandatory RDP Network Level Authentication regarding Privileged Remote Access (PRA) connections.
An update was released to provide support for AppProtection for Private Application Traffic (formerly Inspection) using the WebSocket communication protocol. To learn more, see WebSocket Controls.
An update was released to provide support for VMware’s Unified Access Gateway (UAG).
An update was released to support upcoming functionality changes for TCP Quick Acknowledgement to improve performance of applications that use specific protocols.
An update was released to support upcoming functionality changes to provide App Connector platform and host OS details in the App Connector Status Diagnostics and the App Connector page.

blocks.text: Your App Connectors will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per App Connector group. To learn more, see About App Connector Software Updates.
An optional update was released for the App Connector Manager software to support improvements to how provisioning keys are handled. To learn more, see About the Manager Software.
Your App Connectors will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per App Connector group. To learn more, see About App Connector Software Updates.
The following issues were resolved:

blocks.item: An update was released to address performance enhancements in the Dockerized App Connector containers. To learn more, see the App Connector Deployment Guide for Docker.
An update was released to address an App Connector logging issue due to unpacking fonts when updating the App Connector software version.

blocks.text: An update was released to support upcoming functionality changes to use the TCP Keepalive socket option at the application segment level.
Your App Connectors will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per App Connector group. To learn more, see About App Connector Software Updates.
This App Connector software version includes improvements to support Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) cloud changes.
Your App Connectors will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per App Connector group. To learn more, see About App Connector Software Updates.
An update was released to address an Open SSL issue.
Your App Connectors will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per App Connector group. To learn more, see About App Connector Software Updates.

An update was released to address an issue where App Connectors with Health Reporting set to On Access or Continuous failed to access applications with a single domain or multiple domains, and with total bytes that exceeded 200 characters.
Your App Connectors will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per App Connector group. To learn more, see About App Connector Software Updates.
This App Connector software version includes the following updates:

blocks.item: App Connectors now provide support for Privileged Remote Access to applications that support Secure Shell Protocol (SSH) and Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP). Privileged Remote Access is only supported on App Connectors running CentOS 7.8 and above. To learn more, see Privileged Remote Access, App Connector Deployment Prerequisites, and Managing Deployed App Connectors.
An update was released for the App Connector Manager software to support Privileged Remote Access functionality.
App Connector remote troubleshooting, when enabled, is enhanced to include the execution of TCP and ICMP ping commands for App Connectors.

blocks.text: Your App Connectors will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per App Connector group. To learn more, see About App Connector Software Updates.
Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) now supports collecting App Connector data remotely to assist in troubleshooting by executing DNS resolve and restart commands on App Connectors when enabled.
Your App Connectors will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per App Connector group. To learn more, see About App Connector Software Updates.
